name: spinnaker-mcp
description: Exposes a Spinnaker instance through its Gate API as 37 tools: applications, pipelines, executions, deployment strategies and infrastructure.

GATE_URL.description: Spinnaker Gate API endpoint, without a trailing slash

GATE_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for Gate authentication; leave empty for a Gate without authentication

tools.name: list_applications
tools.description: List all Spinnaker applications

tools.name: get_application
tools.description: Get detailed application info (accounts, clusters, attributes)

tools.name: list_pipelines
tools.description: List pipeline configurations for an application

tools.name: get_pipeline
tools.description: Get a specific pipeline's full configuration

tools.name: trigger_pipeline
tools.description: Trigger a pipeline with optional parameters

tools.name: save_pipeline
tools.description: Save/create a pipeline definition

tools.name: update_pipeline
tools.description: Update an existing pipeline definition

tools.name: delete_pipeline
tools.description: Delete a pipeline definition

tools.name: get_pipeline_history
tools.description: Get revision history for a pipeline config

tools.name: list_executions
tools.description: List recent executions, filterable by status

tools.name: get_execution
tools.description: Get full execution details (stages, outputs, timing)

tools.name: search_executions
tools.description: Rich search by trigger type, time range, status

tools.name: cancel_execution
tools.description: Cancel a running execution with optional reason

tools.name: pause_execution
tools.description: Pause a running execution at the current stage

tools.name: resume_execution
tools.description: Resume a paused execution

tools.name: restart_stage
tools.description: Restart a failed stage within an execution

tools.name: evaluate_expression
tools.description: Evaluate a SpEL expression against an execution

tools.name: list_strategies
tools.description: List deployment strategy configurations

tools.name: save_strategy
tools.description: Create or update a deployment strategy

tools.name: delete_strategy
tools.description: Delete a deployment strategy

tools.name: list_server_groups
tools.description: List server groups (deployment targets) with instance counts

tools.name: list_load_balancers
tools.description: List load balancers across all accounts and regions

tools.name: list_clusters
tools.description: List cluster names grouped by account

tools.name: get_cluster
tools.description: Get cluster details including server groups

tools.name: get_scaling_activities
tools.description: Get scaling activities for a cluster

tools.name: get_target_server_group
tools.description: Target-based server group lookup (newest, oldest, etc.)

tools.name: list_firewalls
tools.description: List all firewalls/security groups across accounts

tools.name: get_firewall
tools.description: Get firewall details by account, region, and name

tools.name: get_instance
tools.description: Get instance details (health, metadata, launch time)

tools.name: get_console_output
tools.description: Get instance console output for debugging

tools.name: find_images
tools.description: Search for machine images by tags, region, account

tools.name: get_image_tags
tools.description: List image tags for a repository

tools.name: list_networks
tools.description: List VPCs/networks by cloud provider

tools.name: list_subnets
tools.description: List subnets by cloud provider

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List all configured cloud accounts/credentials

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Get account details and permissions

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get orchestration task status (deploy, resize, rollback)

npm.description: Run the npm package over stdio; needs Node 18 or newer

examples.title: Find failed executions
examples.description: List the recent executions of an application filtered by status
examples.prompt: List the failed pipeline executions of the application myapp in Spinnaker and summarize which stage failed in each.

examples.title: Read a pipeline before triggering it
examples.description: Fetch a pipeline's configuration and explain it
examples.prompt: Show me the configuration of the deploy-prod pipeline of the application myapp and explain its stages.
